title: TOO BIG
text: TOO BIG. I AM 5'2" AND THIS PILLOW IS TOO BIG AND HEAVY FOR ME.  IT WILL PROBABLY WORK GREAT FOR SOMEONE TALLER AND STRONGER.  IT WORKED GREAT IF SOMEONE WERE AROUND TO HELP ME GET ON AND OFF OF IT. LOL

product_metadata.title: Ebung Leg Elevation Pillow with Memory Foam & Cooling Gel - Elevated Leg Pillows for Sleeping, Blood Circulation, Leg Swelling Relief, and Sciatica Pain Relief - Pillow for Back Pain and Pregnancy
features: ERGONOMIC DESIGN & COOLING GEL - With the pillow's ergonomic design, it relieves swelling and pain while reducing edema and plantar fascitis. Our leg pillows for sleeping can be used for sciatica pain relief or as a pregnancy wedge pillow. It features top layer of cooling gel to moderate body temperature for enhanced comfort and restful sleep.
PERFECT SIZE & SHAPE - Leg elevation pillow measures 24" (L) x 21" (W) x 8" (H) - the perfect size orthopedic pillow to prop on your bed, couch, or other surface.
WASHABLE & REPLACEABLE COVER - This includes replaceable wedge pillow cover that is machine-washable and hypoallergenic. Additional dust-proof and breathable cover can be purchased separately.

VERSATILE USES - This ergonomic pillow is designed to take pressure off of legs and knees and to alleviate hip pain. Great as a postpartum pillow, post-surgery pillow, recliner pillow, bed pillow, back pillow, orthopedic pillow, or leg wedge pillow.

PREMIUM QUALITY - Made with premium-quality, high-density memory foam, this elevated pillow is sturdy enough to retain its shape through continued use. Pillow comes compressed when shipped and will need to be left open to inflate and provide you with the best shape.
